mutants.name: samefile-to-realpath-string
mutants.why: replacing samefile with the old realpath-string comparison makes a case-variant spelling of the same directory compare as a different directory, reproducing thread 324; t13 asserts the variant matches on a case-insensitive filesystem

mutants.name: missing-directory-raises
mutants.why: narrowing except OSError to except TypeError lets FileNotFoundError (a subclass of OSError, not TypeError) propagate when the agent's directory no longer exists; t9 asserts _agent_owns_root returns False for a moved directory

mutants.name: none-test-removed
mutants.why: removing the None guard lets os.path.samefile(None, root) raise TypeError, which is not caught by except OSError and propagates instead of returning False; t9 asserts _agent_owns_root returns False when _agent_root returns None
